name: single_guided
scope: Python standard-library JSON CLI for deterministic onboarding eligibility, blockers, topological planning and atomically validated progress updates.

input_contract.steps: List of unique nonblank IDs with a nonblank string action; optional prerequisites, required_fields and completion_evidence are unique nonblank string lists. Optional title and description are nonblank strings.
input_contract.progress: Optional object with fields (global literal-key object) and completed (step-ID-keyed records containing an evidence object).
input_contract.updates: Optional fields merge and complete record merge. A batch may complete an entire prerequisite chain. Original and resulting progress must both be valid. No deletion operation.
input_contract.presence: Missing, null, empty strings, whitespace-only strings, empty arrays and empty objects are absent. Boolean false and numeric zero are present.
input_contract.strictness: Unknown structural keys, duplicate JSON keys, duplicate step IDs/list entries, nonfinite JSON constants, unknown prerequisite/completion IDs, cycles and invalid completion claims are rejected.

output_contract.eligible_next_steps: Uncompleted IDs with all prerequisites completed and required fields present. Evidence is required at completion, not eligibility.
output_contract.blocked_reasons: Uncompleted blocked IDs mapped to structured missing_prerequisites and/or missing_required_fields reasons.
output_contract.topological_plan: All remaining steps, including blocked ones, in lexical-ID-tiebroken Kahn topological order. This is not a guarantee that every step is immediately executable.
output_contract.progress: Merged validated state; caller must persist this returned JSON.
output_contract.steps: Normalized full step definitions in deterministic topological order, with any validated wording overrides.
output_contract.errors: JSON error object on stdout with exit code 2; success JSON on stdout with exit code 0.

wording_callback.contract: Receives a deep copy of normalized steps. Returns a mapping of configured step IDs to nonblank title/description overrides only. Unknown IDs and action/dependency/other structural overrides are rejected.
wording_callback.isolation: Mutating callback input cannot mutate planner state or caller input. Callback is library-only and not loaded or invoked by the CLI.

limitations: Evidence and field values are checked for presence only, not truth, type-specific business validity, ownership, authenticity or external execution.
Actions are opaque strings and are never executed.
No persistent storage, authentication, multiple-user isolation, timestamps, revocation, conditional prerequisites or concurrent update control.
Callback code is trusted in-process Python, not a sandbox; only its returned structure and mutation isolation are enforced.
JSON-shaped inputs are expected for direct library use; CLI enforces JSON parsing.
Cycle errors identify unresolved IDs, which can include downstream steps, not necessarily a minimal cycle.
No network, provider calls, packages, usage estimates, financial estimates or client scoring.
fixtures: All example and test identities, actions and evidence are clearly fictional.

coverage: callback wording, ID validation and structural preservation
duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite constants
CLI error handling and example subprocess
